name: Business Text - Company and People
text: Apple Inc. CEO Tim Cook announced the new iPhone at the Steve Jobs Theater in Cupertino, California on September 12, 2023.

name: News Article - Political
text: President Joe Biden met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the White House in Washington D.C. to discuss trade relations between the United States and India.

name: Financial Text
text: Microsoft Corporation reported quarterly revenue of $56.5 billion, exceeding Wall Street expectations. CEO Satya Nadella credited strong Azure cloud growth.

name: Medical Text
text: Dr. Sarah Johnson from Johns Hopkins University published research on COVID-19 vaccines in The Lancet medical journal.

name: Historical Text
text: On July 20, 1969, Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the Moon during NASA's Apollo 11 mission.

name: Sports Text
text: Lionel Messi scored two goals for Inter Miami CF in their match against New York Red Bulls at DRV PNK Stadium in Fort Lauderdale.

name: Technology Text
text: OpenAI released GPT-4 in March 2023, marking a significant advancement in artificial intelligence. The model was developed by a team led by Sam Altman.

name: Legal Text
text: The Supreme Court of the United States ruled in favor of Google LLC in the copyright case brought by Oracle Corporation regarding Java API usage.

name: Complex Multi-Entity Text
text: The European Union headquarters in Brussels hosted a summit on December 10, 2023, where leaders including Emmanuel Macron of France and Olaf Scholz of Germany discussed climate policy.
